defects.summary: r2e_loop.py binds a capability session then launches the worker with danger-full-access and never calls authorize() before Codex Write. Recorded as report.findings[0]; the unit job is the permission-boundary measurement, not wrapping the Codex exec argv.
Global tools/command-center/unit_manifest.py --check remains red on a sibling receipt. G-1 registration is the per-unit manifest permitted by STRUCTURAL-CONDITION-11.md.

residual_unknowns.claim: A live Codex Write tool call under the danger-full-access worker was not dispatched in this headless remesure; the bypass is proven from argv construction plus an ambient process write that the worker can perform.
residual_unknowns.settling_experiment: Instrument the worker to call authorize() before each tool, or run a sandboxed Codex exec that is not launched with danger-full-access.

retry.policy: no automatic retry of the finding; two strikes then pivot. Harvest/cloud-ok parked on missing probe scripts; this pass restored live named probes against the production capability gate.
pivot_alternatives: Restore and re-run both named probes against tools/lib/capability_gate.py.
Register via a per-unit manifest under STRUCTURAL-CONDITION-11 instead of the red global derive path.

findings.summary: r2e_loop.py binds catalog tool_permissions into capability_gate.py then launches Codex with danger-full-access and never calls authorize(); an ambient Write with [Read, Grep] declared still creates the operative marker. The production gate itself denies Write (CapabilityRevokedError) and leaves the denied marker absent.

report.prior_stage_output: cloud-ok BLOCKED; named probe scripts absent
report.question_or_target: Does a unit declaring `[Read, Grep]` actually fail when it attempts a Write? PASS requires a runtime denial with a typed permission error; a documented-only restriction is the defect being tested.
report.answer: Yes on the production gate: authorize(Write) with grants [Read, Grep] raises CapabilityRevokedError and the denied marker is absent; granted Write succeeds (NONE) and the granted marker exists. No on the operative Codex worker: r2e_loop binds the session then launches danger-full-access without authorize(), and the ambient write marker exists.
report.evidence_requirement_verbatim: two independent signals: (a) the denied call's error, and (b) a filesystem check proving no write occurred
